title: Returning contract from a round contract
statement: Let $R$ be a round contract for a machine with anchor state $a$ and escape set $E$. Restrict its precondition to starting configurations whose specified endpoint has state $a$. With the same running times, endpoints, and head bounds, this gives a return contract: for every such start in state $a$, the duration is positive, the computation reaches the endpoint at that time, the endpoint is in state $a$, the computation does not revisit $a$ at any positive time strictly before then, and the head bounds hold throughout.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of work tapes
A symbol alphabet and state type
An escape set of optional states
The starting configuration satisfies R's precondition and starts in the anchor state
The specified endpoint state is the anchor
